Match the hotel department in List I with its operational responsibility in List II:

List I:
(A) Front Office
(B) Housekeeping
(C) Food and Beverage (F&B) Service
(D) Food Production (Kitchen)

List II:
(I) Reservations, guest registration, room allotment, concierge, bell desk, and cashiering
(II) Cleanliness, sanitation, aesthetic decor, linen room, and servicing of guest rooms and public areas
(III) Operation of restaurants, banquets, room service (in-room dining), and bars
(IV) Culinary preparation, recipe standardization, hygiene, and cooking of all menu items

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Front Office manages guest entry/billing; Housekeeping ensures cleanliness; F&B Service runs dining outlets; Food Production cooks culinary items.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

questionText: What does 'MRP (inclusive of all taxes)' printed on goods signify under Indian law?

options.text: The absolute maximum price a retailer can legally charge; charging even one rupee above the printed MRP is a punishable offense
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for MRP (Maximum Retail Price) Inclusiveness.

options.text: The wholesale cost of production for the manufacturer
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A suggestion that shopkeepers can ignore
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: The minimum price below which goods cannot be sold
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Resource Management (MRP (Maximum Retail Price) Inclusiveness):
The absolute maximum price a retailer can legally charge; charging even one rupee above the printed MRP is a punishable offense

Detailed Context:
MRP is the statutory price ceiling inclusive of all taxes; charging beyond the printed MRP constitutes an illegal unfair trade practice.
Hence Option A is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText: What regulatory body was established for the first time under Section 10 of CPA 2019?

options.text: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) to promote, protect, and enforce consumer rights as a class
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) Mandate.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A private corporate marketing association
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Resource Management (Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) Mandate):
Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) to promote, protect, and enforce consumer rights as a class

Detailed Context:
CCPA acts as an executive regulatory watchdog with power to initiate class actions, order product recalls, and penalize false advertisements.
Hence Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
